documents.body:
Diagnostics and tools Diagnose this computer, see the CLI contract, use the Capturefab shell or access camera registers. capturefab doctor Check this computer: FFmpeg, folders, USB and GigE limits, with a fix for each warning. Effect: read . capturefab doctor capturefab --json doctor capturefab doctor JSON result Field Type and meaning arch string checks [{name,status:ok|warn|fail,message,fix?}] — fix is a command or step that resolves a warning features {usb,jpeg,videotoolbox,nvjpeg,vaapi,keychain,shell} — what this build includes ffmpeg {source:CAPTUREFAB_FFMPEG|bundled|next_to_executable|path,path,version,bundled_error?} or {error} — FFmpeg is looked for in that order; bundled_error says why a bundled copy could not be extracted folders {runtime,state,cache: {path,from,writable,fs_type,passed:[{path,from,why}],error}} — the folders in use (runtime: sessions; state: presets, sign-ins; cache: FFmpeg), path absent when there is none; which candidate each uses (from: a variable, XDG_*, login, home, run, temp, runtime) and the fallbacks passed over host {cpus,threads,cpu_quota,memory:{total_bytes,available_bytes,cgroup_limit_bytes,cgroup_used_bytes,budget_bytes}} — what cgroups leave this process hwdec {selected:auto|none|METHOD,methods:{METHOD:{built,works,reason?}}} — hardware decoding CAPTUREFAB_HWDEC selects, and each method of this platform: in this FFmpeg (built) and proved to decode here (works); only with FFmpeg inspect_dir string, absent when there is none — the private folder inspect writes previews to without --preview PATH jpeg {selected:auto|cpu|videotoolbox|nvjpeg|vaapi,backends:{libjpeg_turbo:{compiled,simd},videotoolbox|nvjpeg|vaapi:{compiled,available,verified?,reason?,version?,driver?,device?,integrated?,upload?:in-place|dma|copy}}} — the JPEG encoder CAPTUREFAB_JPEG selects; verified: the engine encoded a test frame as accurately as libjpeg-turbo, checked once a boot (a failure again after five minutes) and kept in the cache; nvjpeg and vaapi (Linux) run in a helper process; upload: how frames reach the GPU (read where the camera wrote them, one DMA, or written into its memory) os string read_only_root bool, absent off Linux or when it cannot tell — the root file system is mounted read-only version string — Capturefab version warm_sessions bool — camera commands can keep their camera open in the auto session Errors: usage , failed , camera_not_found , camera_ambiguous , camera_busy , permission_denied , disconnected , auth_required , auth_rejected , session_not_found , ffmpeg_missing , unavailable , timeout . capturefab schema Describe commands, arguments, results and error codes as JSON. Effect: read . capturefab schema arguments Argument or option Meaning Details [COMMAND...] A command, such as set or preset apply — capturefab schema capturefab schema set capturefab schema preset apply capturefab schema JSON result Field Type and meaning commands {name: [effect, summary]} — effect: read|file_write|camera_write|disruptive contract_version int conventions {...} effect_with {name: {flag: effect}} — flags that widen a command's effect errors {code: [exit, meaning]} — every error.code exit_codes {exit: meaning} grammars {selector,name,duration,template} Errors: usage , failed , camera_not_found , camera_ambiguous , camera_busy , permission_denied , disconnected , auth_required , auth_rejected , session_not_found , ffmpeg_missing , unavailable , timeout . capturefab shell Run commands one after another with the cameras kept connected: a prompt in a terminal, one command a line otherwise. Effect: disruptive . Commands are the ones above without capturefab . In a terminal: line editing, history, Tab completion, use CAM , cameras , show , help , exit ; Ctrl-C stops the command running. Otherwise each line of stdin (or each -e) runs in order and prints one result, one JSON line each with --json; the first failure ends the run unless --keep-going, and sets the exit code. capturefab shell arguments Argument or option Meaning Details -c , --camera CAM Cameras to connect now and keep connected, repeatable; the first is the camera of commands without -c env CAPTUREFAB_CAMERA ; repeatable -e , --execute COMMAND Run COMMAND, then the next -e, instead of reading stdin; repeatable repeatable --keep-going Without a terminal: go on after a command fails; the exit code is then the first failure's — --keep DUR Keep the cameras open in a session for this long after the shell's last use (default 60s; 0 holds them in the shell's own process) env CAPTUREFAB_KEEP capturefab shell -c sim:0 printf 'set exposure=5ms
capture -o a.png
inspect
' | capturefab shell -c sim:0 --json capturefab shell -c sim:0 -e 'set gain=0' -e 'capture -o shot.png' capturefab shell JSON result Field Type and meaning cameras {cameras:[{id,state:connecting|connected|failed,default?,session?,error?}]} help {help} — the text of help COMMAND, or of a line's --help lines input: one command a line on stdin (blank and # lines skipped), or each -e; output: one line per command run, in order, its result or {error} as that command prints it (NDJSON with --json); the exit code is the first failure's use {camera?} — the default camera Errors: usage , failed , invalid_duration , feature_not_found , out_of_range , invalid_choice , not_writable , feature_locked , camera_ambiguous , camera_not_found , camera_busy , permission_denied , disconnected , worker_crashed , session_not_found , ffmpeg_missing , unavailable , auth_required , auth_rejected , frame_timeout , trigger_timeout , timeout , unsupported , exists , storage_full , incomplete , interrupted . capturefab completions Print shell completions: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, elvish. Effect: read . capturefab completions arguments Argument or option Meaning Details SHELL one of bash , elvish , fish , powershell , zsh capturefab completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_capturefab capturefab completions bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/capturefab capturefab completions JSON result Field Type and meaning script string — with --json: the completion script; without it, the script alone shell string — with --json Errors: usage , failed , camera_not_found , camera_ambiguous , camera_busy , permission_denied , disconnected , auth_required , auth_rejected , session_not_found , ffmpeg_missing , unavailable , timeout . capturefab debug Protocol tools: GenICam XML, raw registers, one session request. capturefab debug xml -c sim:0 > camera.xml capturefab debug read -c sim:0 0x100 4 echo '{"op":"status"}' | capturefab --session bench debug rpc capturefab debug read Read raw camera memory. Effect: read . capturefab debug read arguments Argument or option Meaning Details -c , --camera CAM Camera ID, serial, IP address, stream URL, file path or simulator (sim:0) env CAPTUREFAB_CAMERA ADDRESS Address: decimal or 0x hexadecimal — [LENGTH] Bytes to read, 1..65536 default 4 capturefab debug read -c sim:0 0x100 4 capturefab --json debug read -c gige:00c0df123456 0x0938 capturefab debug read JSON result Field Type and meaning address int hex string — the bytes read Errors: usage , failed , camera_not_found , camera_ambiguous , camera_busy , permission_denied , disconnected , auth_required , auth_rejected , session_not_found , ffmpeg_missing , unavailable , timeout . capturefab debug rpc Send one session command, a JSON object on stdin, and print its reply. Effect: disruptive . capturefab debug rpc arguments Argument or option Meaning Details -c , --camera CAM Camera ID, serial, IP address, stream URL, file path or simulator (sim:0) env CAPTUREFAB_CAMERA echo '{"op":"get_values","names":[{"name":"Width"}]}' | capturefab debug rpc -c sim:0 echo '{"op":"status"}' | capturefab --session bench debug rpc Errors: usage , failed , camera_not_found , camera_ambiguous , camera_busy , permission_denied , disconnected , auth_required , auth_rejected , session_not_found , ffmpeg_missing , unavailable , timeout . capturefab debug write Write raw camera memory. Effect: disruptive . capturefab debug write arguments Argument or option Meaning Details -c , --camera CAM Camera ID, serial, IP address, stream URL, file path or simulator (sim:0) env CAPTUREFAB_CAMERA ADDRESS Address: decimal or 0x hexadecimal — DATA Hex bytes, such as 00000001 — capturefab debug write -c sim:0 0x100 80020000 capturefab --json debug write -c gige:00c0df123456 0x0a00 00000002 capturefab debug write JSON result Field Type and meaning address int written int — bytes Errors: usage , failed , camera_not_found , camera_ambiguous , camera_busy , permission_denied , disconnected , auth_required , auth_rejected , session_not_found , ffmpeg_missing , unavailable , timeout . capturefab debug xml Print a camera's GenICam XML, or write it to a file. Effect: read . capturefab debug xml arguments Argument or option Meaning Details -c , --camera CAM Camera ID, serial, IP address, stream URL, file path or simulator (sim:0) env CAPTUREFAB_CAMERA -o , --output FILE The file to write; it must not exist effect file_write capturefab debug xml -c sim:0 > camera.xml capturefab debug xml -c gige:00c0df123456 -o camera.xml capturefab debug xml JSON result Field Type and meaning bytes int — with -o path string — with -o xml string — without -o Errors: usage , failed , exists , storage_full , camera_not_found , unsupported . capturefab licenses Print Capturefab's license and the bundled FFmpeg's license notice. Effect: read . capturefab licenses capturefab --json licenses capturefab licenses JSON result Field Type and meaning capturefab string — Capturefab's MIT license ffmpeg string — the bundled FFmpeg's GPL notice and license texts, or a note that this build has none Errors: usage , failed , camera_not_found , camera_ambiguous , camera_busy , permission_denied , disconnected , auth_required , auth_rejected , session_not_found , ffmpeg_missing , unavailable , timeout .
